pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit high-frequency, jagged edge gradients with fractal-like angularity. Individual patches are irregularly polygonal with sharp, non-linear boundaries. Spatial area is largest on the upper flank and neck, transitioning to significantly smaller, more frequent units toward the ventral midline.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a dense, narrow dendritic network. Junction nodes are numerous and irregular. The pixel thickness of the pathways is minimal and inconsistent, frequently interrupted by the serrated protrusions of the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D contour along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder, creating a brush-like silhouette against the sky.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A subtle structural break or thinning of the mane density is visible at the transition point between the posterior neck and the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, semi-spherical protrusion is visible on the ventral midline, consistent with an umbilical hernia or similar anatomical anomaly.
